description: This file defines the ScreenPermissionService class, which manages access permissions for screens within the application, including retrieving permissions for modules and actions, and interfacing with DAOs for data access.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionService
classes.description: Service class for handling screen permission logic, including retrieval of permissions and associated screen data.

methods.name: getScreenDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ScreenDao instance used to access screen data.

methods.name: setScreenDao
methods.description: Sets the ScreenDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ScreenPermissionDao instance used to access screen permission data.

methods.name: setScreenPermissionDao
methods.description: Sets the ScreenPermissionDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permission details for a specified module and action URL, based on user roles.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Fetches a Screen entity based on module and action URL.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Gets the current module and screen context from the helper.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current Screen entity based on the current module and screen context.
